description: "Eight planned joint studies of the Human- and Society-Centered AI Research Network."
---

::: {.page-lead}
The portfolio grows from studies already under way and from real institutional, industrial and social questions. Studies are selected by their theoretical contribution, the empirical evidence available, ethical feasibility and the possibility of external validation – not by artificial deadlines. In publications we always distinguish completed studies, preliminary results and proposed experiments.
:::

  <article class="study-card"><span class="status">Planned</span><h3>Organizational development at the university</h3>

    <p>Expert-validated exploration of stakeholder impacts and risks of AI-supported decisions, including the sensitivity of results to the model and the prompt.</p>

## Publication plan

A joint, internationally targeted concept paper on the integrated mechanism and impact model; methodological papers on persona-based impact assessment, risk-based governance and the measurement of organizational interventions; and empirical case studies. Results will appear on the [Publications](/publications.html) page.
